# Applied Information Services

> A consulting and services firm for complex domains.

Applied Information Services, LLC is a consulting and services firm for complex domains and the publisher of JANN, the Joint AEROSINT News Network.

## Pages

- [Capabilities](https://appliedinformationservices.com/services.html): Capability areas and service lines.
- [About](https://appliedinformationservices.com/about.html): What Applied is, and key facts.
- [FAQ](https://appliedinformationservices.com/faq.html): Frequently asked questions.
- [JANN](https://appliedinformationservices.com/jann.html): JANN and The AEROSINT, Applied's publication.

## Industry Classifications

- NAICS 541690 — Other Scientific & Technical Consulting Services: Structured analysis, open-source research, and technical advisory services across aerospace, defense, and government domains.
- NAICS 519290 — Web Search Portals and All Other Information Services: Open-source aerospace and defense intelligence monitoring and subscription-based information products.
- NAICS 541618 — Other Management Consulting Services: Program and acquisition decision support; advisory engagements spanning organizational and operational challenges.
- NAICS 611430 — Professional & Management Development Training: Structured training programs for analysts, program managers, and intelligence professionals.

## Key facts

- Company: Applied Information Services, LLC (Montana limited liability company, Kalispell), founded 2025
